firmware-updates.page.title: Firmware Updates
firmware-updates.page.intro: New Buddy firmware is read from Prusa's GitHub releases. Each printer follows the default channel ({channel}) unless you choose another one on its Status tab. Nothing is installed on its own.
firmware-updates.page.how: To update a printer, open it, go to its Status tab, and use the Firmware Updates section: first copy the firmware to the printer's USB drive, then start the installation. The default channel, the MINI language and the check interval are on Settings → Extensions → Firmware Updates.
firmware-updates.section.betaHint: This printer is offered alpha, beta and release-candidate firmware. Pre-releases can have bugs.
firmware-updates.section.noOffer: No firmware on this channel yet. Check again later.
firmware-updates.section.transferring: Downloading and copying to the printer's USB drive…
firmware-updates.section.transferred: The firmware is on the printer as {path}. It is not installed yet.
firmware-updates.section.flashing: The printer is installing the firmware and restarts. It reconnects by itself in a few minutes.
firmware-updates.confirmTransfer.title: Copy the firmware to the printer?
firmware-updates.confirmTransfer.body: Firmware {version} is downloaded from GitHub and copied to the USB drive of {name}. Nothing is installed yet.
firmware-updates.confirmFlash.title: Install the firmware now?
firmware-updates.confirmFlash.body: {name} restarts at once and installs firmware {version}. Do this only while it is not printing. Do not switch it off during the installation.
